description_excerpt: Job Description An SAP Consultant Intern supports the implementation, configuration, and testing of SAP modules (e.g., FICO, SD, MM) by translating business requirements into technical solutions. Responsibilities include assisting with system upgrades, creating technical documentation, troubleshooting issues, and collaborating with functional teams on end-to-end projects.
